title: Interior Designer Agent — Project Master (Single Source of Truth)
description: Schema R01-A. Every information-bearing value MUST be a provenance-wrapped fact. Bare scalars are rejected by design.

external_ref.description: Mandatory citation block for anything coming from outside the project.

applicability_note.description: Why this external figure may or may not apply to THIS project. Never assume it does.

fact.description: Provenance-wrapped value. RULE: no value may exist in the master without status + source.

value.description: any type, or null when status = U

presence.description: TRI-STATE (Gate 00.5-A R02 §3). PRESENT = element exists and has data. NOT_PRESENT = client CONFIRMED it does not exist. UNKNOWN = nobody knows. An empty field is NEVER evidence of absence.

derivation_type.description: A [D] may ONLY be a deterministic computation. Any preference, selection or design judgement is a [P], never a [D].

conflict.description: KNOWN CONFLICT flag (Spec R01 §7.4). Surfaces on every generated output until resolved.

allOf.$comment: RULE F1 — AI is never a source of truth (Spec R01 §8). Hard rejection.

RULE F2 — [C] only from client input or explicit user approval (Spec R01 §6.2). A CONFIRMED value may not be null, EXCEPT for a confirmed absence (presence=NOT_PRESENT), where null is the correct representation of 'this element does not exist'.
RULE F3 — a [C] created by approval must carry a full Decision Record (Spec R01 §9).
RULE F4 — [D] must show its inputs, its formula, and declare a deterministic derivation type (Gate 00.5-A R02 §2).
RULE F10 — a [D] can never be locked directly and can never carry a decision_id: a derived value is a consequence, not a decision. Design choices must be [P] -> approval -> [C].
RULE T1 — TRI-STATE: confirmed absence. NOT_PRESENT is a positive claim and must be CONFIRMED by the client, with a null value.
RULE T2 — TRI-STATE: an UNKNOWN presence must carry status U. Absence of information is never absence of the element.
RULE T3 — TRI-STATE: PRESENT means there is real data; the value may not be null.
RULE T4 — a [U] fact may never claim the element is absent.
RULE F5 — [A] must be declared, impact-stated, and never silently locked.
RULE F6 — [U] carries no value and must declare blocking status.
RULE F7 — [P] is an agent/external suggestion and can never be locked.
RULE F8 — external standards/libraries can never be [C] directly; they enter as [P] or [D] and require a citation (Gate 00 change #4).
RULE F9 — only a CONFIRMED fact may be locked into the frozen master.

presence_register.description: TRI-STATE guard for whole collections (Gate 00.5-A R02 §5). An empty array is ambiguous: it may mean 'confirmed none' or 'never asked'. This register forces the distinction. Every collection that can legitimately be empty MUST declare its presence here.

test_banner.const: TEST PROJECT — NOT A REAL CLIENT PROJECT

topology_policy.description: Declared topology policy (Gate 00.5-B2 approval). OPTIONAL. Absence of require_closed_envelope means UNSPECIFIED — it does NOT mean false. The engine may never infer this policy from the model's own geometry.

require_closed_envelope.description: true = closure is required, WT-003 applicable. false = closure explicitly not required. Absent = UNSPECIFIED.

allOf.$comment: RULE M1 — a test project must be labelled in the data itself (Gate 00 change #7).
RULE M2 — a frozen master must record when it was frozen and its hash.
RULE SG1 (DEF-CROSS-01c) — a KNOWN ceiling height must be a positive number of millimetres. A negative or zero clear height is impossible by definition. NO standard is applied: 50mm passes this rule.

RULE SG2 (DEF-CROSS-01d) — a KNOWN space outline must carry at least three points. Two points describe a line, which cannot bound an area. This is a topological minimum, not a shape preference: no convexity, closure or size is implied.

RULE WG1 (DEF-CROSS-01a) — a KNOWN wall thickness must be a positive number of millimetres. Zero or negative is mathematically impossible, not a design opinion: B3/B4 consume thickness as th/2.0, so a negative value silently SHRINKS the wall body and turns a real overlap into a false PASS. No minimum thickness is implied — 50mm is accepted.
RULE WG2 (DEF-CROSS-01b) — a KNOWN wall height must be a positive number of millimetres. A wall of negative extent cannot exist. No reasonable height is implied.
RULE DG1 — a KNOWN swing must carry the full minimal geometry. A partial or malformed swing is rejected rather than completed by guesswork. An absent swing stays absent (GAP, not a default).

position_reference.description: GAP-B3-01 fix. Declares WHAT the position coordinate refers to. OPTIONAL field, but its ABSENCE means UNKNOWN — it is never silently read as CENTER. Value must be one of the declared datums.

rotation.description: GAP-B3-02 fix. Rotation in degrees, counter-clockwise, about the position point. OPTIONAL field, but its ABSENCE means UNKNOWN — it is never silently read as 0. An explicit 0 must be stated as a value.

allOf.$comment: RULE FG1 — a KNOWN position_reference must name a declared datum. Invalid datums are rejected rather than guessed.
RULE FG2 — a KNOWN rotation must be a finite number of degrees. Explicit 0 is allowed; a missing field is UNKNOWN, not 0.

camera.description: Frozen camera definition so any view can be reproduced identically (Spec R01 §13 check 10).

allOf.$comment: RULE P1 — an approved proposal must point at its Decision Record (Spec R01 §9).
RULE CR1 — NO AUTO-APPLY. An applied CR must carry approval + revision, regardless of MINOR/MAJOR (Gate 00 change #1).
RULE TF1 — Technical Fix proof obligations (Gate 00 change #3). Hash equal, revision equal, geometry version equal, tests re-run, zero regressions.
RULE CR2 — a CR_APPLIED changelog line must name its CR.

output.description: Registry of every produced file, with its class and binding strength (Gate 00 changes #1 and #2).

allOf.$comment: RULE O1 — Class A: deterministic geometric match, binding in both senses.
RULE O2 — Class B: geometry derived from the same master, visual treatment may differ; NEVER a substitute for A (Gate 00 change #1).
RULE O3 — Class C: non-binding, and the word 100% / مطابق / exact is forbidden in its caption (Gate 00 change #2).

circulation_path.description: A declared movement/circulation path. Geometry and endpoints are DECLARED data, never inferred. Absence of the collection means no path has been declared, NOT that the space has no circulation.

centerline.description: Ordered list of [x,y] points in mm. Two points minimum.

start_ref.description: Element id this path starts at. Must resolve.

end_ref.description: Element id this path ends at. Must resolve.

required_width.description: Minimum clear width in mm. Enforced ONLY when status is C/D from a trusted source. Absent/untrusted = no rule, never a default number.

segments.description: Alternative to centerline: an ordered list of segments, each [[x1,y1],[x2,y2]] in mm. This representation CAN express a gap between consecutive segments, which centerline cannot.

allOf.$comment: RULE CP1 — a path declares its geometry exactly one way: a centerline polyline OR an explicit segment list. Never both, never neither, so the representation is never guessed.

swing_geometry.description: MINIMAL swing representation (Phase 00.5-B5). These are the only three values without which a swing arc cannot be computed. Declaring swing is OPTIONAL; if it is absent the agent records a GAP and computes nothing. It NEVER assumes a hinge side, an opening side or an angle.

hinge.description: Which end of the aperture the leaf is hinged on, measured along the host wall from its start point.

side.description: Which side of the host wall the leaf opens towards, as the sign of the wall normal. Declared, never inferred.
